card.name: Strength number inside tablet counts
card.fires_on: Spots just before or inside the per-unit strength (like 50 mg or 20 mg) in dosing tables that describe a dose as a number of tablets or capsules. Includes the space, the digit, or 'of the' before the strength.

modes.label: Space before strength
modes.description: The gap right before a strength number after a count of tablets or capsules.
